name: Codimension-One Staircase q-Cap Obstructions
statement: Let $X=\{a,b,c,z,q\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$ and $U=W\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{z\}$. Delete the four-state staircase scaffold, the anchored subcube over $U$, and the codimension-one q-cap over $W$. The complement $\mathcal K_d^{\mathrm{st},\mathrm{qcap}}$ is a learning space rooted at $\{b,c\}$. Its endpoint repair sets are $\{a,b,c\}$ and $U\cup\{q\}$, so the empty-endpoint pendant extension is a contraction-minimal nonlearning partial cube of order $2^d-3\cdot2^{d-5}-3$.
proof: Translation by $\{b,c\}$ exposes two hereditary anchored blocks and the staircase scaffold, proving union closure; a casewise deletion proves accessibility. Rooted-union witnesses give the exact holes, whose repair sets cover every coordinate. The critical-antipodal pendant criterion yields contraction-minimality, and the three disjoint deleted blocks give the order.
